svg.text: GEOFF — Git-backed Evidence Operations Forensic Framework
System Architecture · multi-agent DFIR platform · "Follow every thread"
THE GEOFF TRIAD — AUTONOMOUS AGENT LOOP
reviews triage → approves plan · decides approve / flag / replay
two independent models check every finding
each step = {module, function, params} per evidence type · playbooks/*.md
everything versioned in a per-case git repo

g.text: ▸ Chain of custody — every step git-committed with SHA-256 sidecar before advancing
▸ Hallucination defense — two independent critics must agree; dissent lowers confidence
▸ Self-healing — deterministic fix first, LLM HealDecision second, targeted replay last
▸ Evidence safety — read-only processing · SHA-256 manifest · originals never modified
▸ Reproducibility — audit_trail.jsonl + ProvenanceDAG trace every finding to its source

svg.text: No per-step human approval — the Triad plans, executes, critiques, and self-corrects autonomously.
served via Web UI · HTTP · MCP

FLOW 1 submit evidence → 2 triage & inventory → 3 Manager approves plan → 4 Forensicator runs SIFT specialists → 5 git custody commit → 6 dual-critic validation → 7 Manager approve / flag / replay → 8 enrichment & provenance → 9 narrative report served back to the analyst
